تستنجدون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْجِدُونَ (tastanjidūna) /tas.tan.d͡ʒi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# تُسْتَنْجَدُونَ (tustanjadūna) /tus.tan.d͡ʒa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
